name: IBSI 1 digital phantom - QICOM/MIRP
scope: All numeric reference/tolerance rows in the digital phantom worksheet of the pinned IBSI 1 workbook, using QICOM with MIRP 2.7.0.

license.reference_spreadsheet: No machine-readable redistribution grant is stated on the download page; QICOM downloads the official file on explicit user consent and does not redistribute it.

reference_values.near_zero_comparison_rule: A reference value whose magnitude is at or below relative_zero_threshold has no significant-digit scale: the untruncated absolute difference is compared against absolute_tolerance, and the relative error is reported as NA.
